en.title: Top K Frequent Elements
en.description:
Output the k most frequent elements, sorted by frequency in descending order and then by value in ascending order.

The standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site are given under "Input".
en.input: n≤100000, −10000≤x≤10000, 1≤k≤distinct. The input contains n k followed by the array.
en.explanation: Count the frequencies, then sort by (-frequency, value).
hints: Count the frequencies, then sort by (-frequency, value).
